problem_statement: A chunked ringbuffer must silently discard an unfinished chunk when a new chunk is started. An unfinished chunk is one that has been opened with crb_start_chunk() and had bytes added with crb_add_byte(), but has not been ended. The test creates such a partial chunk and then calls crb_add_chunk() to add complete chunks; the partial chunk must not be retained or affect the later complete chunks. Today the unfinished chunk is not discarded, so the test fails.
